title: Rooted Canopy — Kraft Impact Cover
description: A recycled-paper-textured cover slide anchored by a single-color hand-drawn tree canopy and a circular year stamp — built for NGO impact reports that lead with sincerity over finish.
philosophy: This design refuses slickness. It exists for organizations that believe the medium is the message — that a recycled-paper texture and an imperfect hand-drawn canopy line communicate institutional trust more honestly than any polished gradient ever could. It is built for the speaker who stands before donors, policymakers, or volunteers and needs the cover slide itself to say 'we are of the earth.' It rejects decorative flourishes that compete with the cause, and it rejects the corporate-clean aesthetic entirely.
goodFor: NGO and nonprofit annual impact report cover slides
Environmental advocacy and land-conservation campaign decks
Earth Day and sustainability publication openers
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly financial reviews requiring dense data layouts
Brands with strict digital-modern or all-white minimal identity standards
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a printed field report pulled from a manila envelope — earnest, grounded, and quietly authoritative. The hand-drawn canopy line should carry organic imperfection, feeling sketched rather than rendered, conveying labor and care over technical precision. Composition breathes through deliberate emptiness: the negative space surrounding the tree and title text is not a void to fill but a statement of restraint and sincerity. Avoid smooth gradients, drop shadows, or any illustrative polish that signals digital fabrication over honest human craft.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed kraft-texture background with no header band or footer bar. The hand-drawn tree canopy dominates the upper two-thirds of the canvas, centered horizontally with its trunk base landing just above the vertical midpoint. Title and subtitle stack in a centered column spanning roughly the middle 60% of canvas width, sitting beneath the canopy in the lower third. A circular year stamp functions as a typographic seal anchored bottom-center or bottom-right, with an open outer margin on all sides preserving deliberate quiet around every text element.

examples.promptCore: The slide evokes a carefully typeset page from a nonprofit field report or a hand-assembled zine — earnest, unhurried, and of-the-earth. Compositional rhythm is asymmetric and breathing: content elements float in generous negative space rather than crowding into tidy containers, with the kraft-paper texture reading as an active visual layer beneath them. Stat callouts or short bullet items carry individual visual weight through size contrast and ruled-line hierarchy alone, never through card backgrounds or drop shadows. Avoid anything that reads as polished UI — no rounded containers, no gradient chips, no icon sets with a digital-modern finish.
